rules.statement: Hexes and Marks are both curse families, but they have different application behavior and target rules; the skill's current tags and wording determine which family it uses.
Damaging ailments are based on the relevant damage of the Hit that inflicts them, then use ailment and Damage over Time modifiers; they are not calculated from the final post-mitigation Hit damage.
Damaging ailments inflicted by critical strikes can receive an ailment Damage over Time multiplier bonus; the exact value and modifiers must be read from the current patch and PoB context.
Non-damaging ailments change action speed, damage taken, resistance, critical chance, or damage dealt rather than dealing damage over time themselves.
